Five Places, One City

Nilufar has lived in the same city for ten years. We asked her about five places where you can hear music.

THE CONCERT HALL. I've been there once. I went last spring, for my father's sixtieth birthday, and we heard an orchestra play for two hours. The tickets were expensive and my father cried in the second half, which I have never seen him do before or since. I haven't been back. I keep meaning to.

THE OLD CAFÉ. This one I know well. There's a band every Friday and the same four people have played there for years. I've been at least thirty times. Last month I took a friend who doesn't like live music and she stayed until midnight, which was not the plan.

THE SUMMER FESTIVAL. I've never been. It's four days in July, in a park by the river, and everybody tells me it's wonderful. Every year I say I'll go and every year something happens — last July I was working, and the year before that it rained for the whole weekend.

THE JAZZ CLUB. I've been twice. The first time I didn't enjoy it at all, because I sat at the back and couldn't see anything. The second time I arrived an hour early, got a table at the front, and understood what everybody was talking about.

THE THEATRE. I've seen one opera in my life, in this building, and I was fifteen. I didn't like it. But I've never forgotten it, and I think that is a different thing.

2

Grammar · present perfect or past simple?

TUSHUNTIRISH — PRESENT PERFECT YOKI PAST SIMPLE?

Ikkala zamonni ham bilasiz. Bu dars ular orasida tanlash haqida — va buni har safar bitta savol hal qiladi.

Q QACHON ekanini aytyapmanmi? Qachon ekanini aytsangiz, past simple ishlatishingiz shart. Aytmasangiz, present perfect ishlating.

PP Present perfect = tajriba. I've been to the concert hall. · I've never been to the festival. Savolda: Have you ever been there? Gap qachon ekanida emas, boʻlganida.

PS Past simple = tafsilotlar. I went last spring. · We heard an orchestra. · I didn't like it. Boʻlganini bilganingizdan keyin qolgan hammasi past simple.

→ Ular birga ishlaydi. Have you ever been to Szimpla Kert? — Yes, I have. I went two weeks ago and they had a really good band. Savol present perfect bilan ochiladi; javob past simple ga oʻtadi.

Past simple ni talab qiladigan vaqt soʻzlari: yesterday · last week · in 2019 · two weeks ago · when I was fifteen. Present perfect bilan keladigan vaqt soʻzlari: ever · never · before · in my life · this month (oy hali tugamagan).

Present perfect — boʻlganmi?

Past simple — tafsilotini ayting

I've been to the jazz club.

I went twice.

Have you ever seen an opera?

Did you like it?

I've never forgotten it.

I was fifteen.

She's played there for years.

She started in 2018.

DIQQAT — IKKI TOMONLAMA XATO

Xato ikkala tomonga ham ketadi, shuning uchun ikkala yoʻnalishda ham tekshiring:

1 Present perfect kerak joyda past simple. ✗ I didn't buy new clothes this month. → ✓ I haven't bought new clothes this month. Bu oy hali tugamagan.

2 Past simple kerak joyda present perfect. ✗ Last year I've been to the National Concert Hall. → ✓ Last year I went to the National Concert Hall. Oʻtgan yil tugagan.

3 Present perfect gapda vaqt soʻzi. ✗ I've seen that film yesterday. → ✓ I saw that film yesterday.

Bir soniyalik tekshiruv. Vaqt iborasini qidiring. Agar u bor va tugagan boʻlsa, feʼl past simple boʻlishi shart. Vaqt iborasi umuman boʻlmasa, deyarli har doim present perfect.

TALAFFUZ — IKKI ZAMON

Ikki zamon butunlay boshqacha eshitiladi, farq esa /v/ yoki /z/ da. I've been → /aɪv biːn/ · I went → /aɪ went/. Feʼldan oldingi oʻsha kichik tovushga quloq soling.

Savolda ham: Have you been…? → /əvju biːn/ · Did you go…? → /dɪdʒə gəʊ/. Yordamchi feʼllarning hech biri urgʻu olmaydi, shuning uchun aniq eshitiladigan yagona soʻz — feʼl, u qaysi zamon ekanini aytadi.

Vocabulary · music

TUSHUNTIRISH — MUSIQA

Musiqa turlari: classical · jazz · opera · rock · pop · folk · dance · world music

Musiqa yaratadigan odamlar: an orchestra · a musician · a band · a DJ · a singer · a rock star

Musiqa eshitiladigan joylar: a concert hall · a club · a music venue · a theatre · a festival

LIVE soʻzi ikki xil aytiladi. I live /lɪv/ in Tashkent — bu feʼl. · live /laɪv/ music — bu sifat, „yozib olinmagan“ degani. Yozilishi bir xil, soʻz boshqa.

Ehtiyot boʻling: an orchestra — katta klassik guruh; a band — kichik va odatda klassik emas. A DJ boshqalarning musiqasini qoʻyadi — a musician esa oʻz musiqasini chaladi.

5

Writing · a film review

TINGLASHDAN YOZISHGA

Avval: Melissa va John ikkalasi bir filmni koʻrishgan. Ular u haqida umuman kelisha olmaydi.

5.1 Listen and answer.

Tinglang va javob bering.

1 What kind of film have they both seen?

2 Did Melissa enjoy it? Did John?

3 What is John going to do this weekend, and what is Melissa going to do?

5.2 Who says it — Melissa (M) or John (J)?

Buni kim aytadi — Melissa (M) mi yoki John (J) mi?

1 You always know what's going to happen.

3 The special effects were great, but that's about all.

2 I thought it was exciting.

4 It's not meant to be too serious.

TAQRIZ QANDAY TUZILADI

Qisqa taqriz taxminan shu tartibda quyidagi savollarga javob beradi:

1 Bu nima va uni kim yaratgan? Film nomi va rejissyori. Nomni bir marta, boshida ayting.

2 U nima haqida? Ikki gap. Oxirini aytmang.

3 Filmning oʻzi haqida nima deb oʻylaysiz? Voqea, tasvir, musiqa.

4 Aktyorlar haqida nima deb oʻylaysiz? Bittasining nomini ayting va nega ekanini tushuntiring.

5 Uni tavsiya qilasizmi? Oxirida bitta aniq gap.

Ehtiyot boʻling: 3- va 4-qismlar alohida. Film va aktyorlar orasida sakrab yuradigan taqrizni kuzatish qiyin.

TAKRORLASHDAN QOCHISH

Ingliz tilida nom qayta-qayta takrorlanmaydi. Bir marta aytganingizdan keyin qisqaroq soʻz ishlating.

Film → it · the film · this film. Roma … Roma … Roma emas.

Odam → she · her · he · his. Yalitza Aparicio … Yalitza Aparicio emas.

Nega muhim. Nomni takrorlash taqrizni boshlovchi yozgandek qilishning eng tez yoʻli. Uni almashtirish — buni tuzatishning eng tez yoʻli.

5.3 Rewrite the paragraph. Replace the repeated words.

Paragrafni qayta yozing. Takrorlangan soʻzlarni almashtiring.

TOO MUCH REPETITION

Roma is a film by Alfonso Cuarón. Roma is in black and white and Roma is set in Mexico City. I saw Roma twice. Yalitza Aparicio plays a maid and Yalitza Aparicio is wonderful. Before Roma, nobody knew Yalitza Aparicio at all.

5.4 Read the model review, then answer.

Namunaviy taqrizni oʻqing, keyin javob bering.

MODEL

A film I have seen three times

The Wind Will Carry Us is a film by the Iranian director Abbas Kiarostami. I've seen it three times and I understand it a little better each time.

It's about a man from the city who arrives in a small village and waits. Almost nothing happens, which is the point. The film is slow, the colours are beautiful, and half the conversations happen with somebody you cannot see.

The acting is very quiet. Most of the people in it are not professional actors — they are villagers — and they do not perform at all. The boy who follows the man around is the best thing in it.

I wouldn't recommend it if you want something exciting. But if you have two hours and you are patient, this film will stay with you for years.

5.5 Answer about the model.

Namuna haqidagi savollarga javob bering.

2 How many times is the title written? How does the writer refer to the film after that?

3 Find one present perfect verb and one past simple verb. Why is each one used?

4 The last sentence does two things at once. What are they?

Avval reja tuzing. Ikki daqiqa, keyin yozing.

Part

5.7 Now write your review (100–120 words) of a film you have seen.

Endi oʻzingiz koʻrgan film haqida taqriz yozing (100–120 soʻz).

TOPSHIRISHDAN OLDIN TEKSHIRING

Beshala qism, tartib bilan.
Nom bir marta, boshida.
Keyin it, the film yoki this film ishlatdim.

Aktyor nomini takrorlash oʻrniga she / he / her / his ishlatdim.
Film va aktyorlar alohida xatboshilarda.

Bitta present perfect (I've seen it…) va tafsilotlar uchun past simple.
Oxirini aytmadim.
Soʻzlarni sanadim.
